The evidence shows we have made significant progress towards achieving these goals. We are about 38% way there and have completed 23 out of 60 major tasks. There is also attached evidence of the successful delivery of Statement of Milestones #1 and substantial progress towards Statement of Milestones #2 for this project.

Please see details and links here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jkIZsR8fwEfR55s4dj6i9TgTmJZoXX6T_bgyyt4QrdI/

The goal for this first milestone was to reach out to the community, collect feedback and provide an updated plan for the token verification project.

The acceptance criteria in the statement of milestones was "The final roadmap showing all necessary individual steps".

The evidence is already in the Monthly Report from November and the updated Statement of Milstones. Here is a quick summary:   

Based on feedback from the Cardano DeFi Aliance and Wingriders we decided to add following features to our initial token verification proposal.

1. Frontend:
 - Submit your own token for verification
 - Search for the verification status of a token
 - Register as a verifier
2. Decentralize signage of a token
 - Allow multiple signatures on a token
 - Provide a list of mappings between institution and signatures/vkeys
 - Revocation (not only signing own tokens -> level of trust may change)
3. Onchain usage of the registry content
 - A trusted institution submits a utxo with a datum, which contains a KV map with the fields of the token registry
 - Institutions can revoke verification by consuming utxo ->  cancel-only contract for storing the utxos

Based on this feedback we decided to update our Roadmap which is reflected in the updated Statement of Milestones. Here are the steps:

1. Community outreach and project outline (done)
2. Development focusing on the smart contract (in progress, due in January)
3. Ongoing backend and frontend development (outstanding)
4. Completion of the token verification project (outstanding)

We have finished the development of our smart contracts.

The evidence has been provided in form of a ZIP file in the monthly report on January 18th 2023 18th 2023.
This ZIP file contains a Github repository which contains the smart contracts and a README with a detailed description. Here is a short summary:

One smart contract is used to register public keys that are associated to a trusted authority, together with metadata about the the authority. Authorities need to post their public key on their website or social media. Users are required to check the correctness of this combinations.

In a second set of smart contract, authorities may place combinations of token policy ids, token names and metadata associated to the token in a single UTxO residing at this contract. They sign this information with their private key, and smart contracts enforce that combinations may only be placed with the authorities public key attached if the signature matches. Authorities may further revoke their placed combinations by spending the corresponding UTxO.

We successfully over-delivered the first and second milestones. The evidence shows we have made significant progress towards achieving these goals. We are about 54.3% way there and have completed 25 of 54 important tasks. There are also many important tasks currently in progress. However, we are currently waiting for funding distribution to sponsor more tickets for the community and progress toward the third milestone for this project.

The website is live and available at https://onchain-token-verification.muesliswap.com/.

As specified in the Milestone's outputs:

  1. The website shows all Cardano native tokens and their respective verification signatures on the landing page.
  2. Users can submit verification requests.
  3. Projects/organizations can create new verification signatures at https://onchain-token-verification.muesliswap.com/entities/register

Additionally, the website also shows a list of registered projects/organizations.

Furthermore, the smart contracts, including extensive documentation, are available at https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/onchain-token-verification.

Finally, the video showcasing the website is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cnrs3yntMVQ.
